name: IP Lab Ventures
decision_note: Prague technology-transfer venture builder whose IP Lab Ventures Fund I received a ~EUR 27m EIF commitment (National Recovery Plan) in September 2026; already holds stakes in university spin-offs such as MendelFOLD and Atomiver.

evidence.quote: With support from the Ministry of Industry and Trade, the European Investment Fund is investing over €27 million from the National Recovery Plan in IP Lab Ventures Fund I

It will invest primarily in projects in artificial intelligence, autonomous systems, robotics, smart mobility, biotechnology and cybersecurity, as well as other promising technology fields such as semiconductors and advanced manufacturing.
The fund aims to support around 40 projects, primarily in the Czech Republic, as well as elsewhere in Central and Eastern Europe.
The fund is targeting more than €50 million (CZK 1.2 billion), including additional private capital.
Fond má podle prezentace zástupců IP Lab Ventures a EIF investovat na úvod až milion eur do jednotlivých firem a podpořit vznik až 40 nových společností.
IP Lab je například součástí spin-offu MendelFOLD vzešlého z Ústavu chemie a biochemie Mendelovy univerzity, úspěchem je i Atomiver z institutu Catrin při olomoucké Univerzitě Palackého.
Pomáhají převádět projekty z univerzit do byznysového světa jako venture Builder, tedy profesionálně, za finanční vklad si berou podíl a na rozvoji se pak ve firmě aktivně podílejí.
V rámci fondu IP Lab Ventures teď s podobným cílem získal 656 milionů korun od Evropského investičního fondu (EIF) s podporou ministerstva průmyslu a obchodu.

The IP Lab Ventures team, which manages the fund, has already established relationships with a number of Czech universities and research organisations and continues to expand and formalise these partnerships.

analyst_notes: Discovered via The Recursive (2026-10-13) and CzechCrunch (2026-09-23); the EIF press release (2026-09-24) is used as the primary LP source. Activity (I3) is the EIF commitment of ~EUR 27m (CZK 656m) to IP Lab Ventures Fund I; no fund-level investment has been announced yet. I2 rests on IP Lab's earlier venture-builder stakes (MendelFOLD, Atomiver; dates not disclosed, Lupa says IP Lab takes equity for a financial contribution). Fund size conflict: EIF says the fund targets more than EUR 50m (CZK 1.2bn), Lupa reports up to EUR 40m; capital left not_disclosed because the fund has not closed. Stage derived from the technology-transfer/spin-off mandate (gap between patent and first pilot sale), not stated as pre-seed/seed. Legal entities: all three IP Lab companies have the same statutory body (the three partners named in the press, per ARES VR); IP Lab Advisor s.r.o. (est. 2026-03-25, owned by IP Lab Holding) is assumed to be the fund's advisor/manager; the fund vehicle itself was not found in ARES (no 'IP Lab Ventures' entity yet). No company website could be confirmed (iplab.cz is an unrelated phone-repair shop).
